visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a blue baseball cap and a black t-shirt featuring a red logo stands in a modern, bright kitchen. He holds a blue-and-brown packaged chicken product toward the camera, speaking with expressive facial movements. (2) The man brings the package closer to the lens, emphasizing the brand and contents. (3) He holds up the internal components: a vacuum-sealed large chicken leg and a small green seasoning packet in his gloved hands. (4) A young girl is seen in a close-up, holding a large, cooked piece of chicken near her face, accompanied by a small white Pomeranian dog looking curious. (5) A close-up shot shows hands using a knife to slice the cooked chicken on a yellow cutting board. (6) The man sprinkles chopped green scallions from his hand into a red, flower-shaped bowl filled with sliced chicken. (7) A close-up shot shows a pair of chopsticks picking up a succulent piece of chicken from the bowl. (8) An adult woman is shown eating a piece of the chicken with chopsticks in the same kitchen environment. (9) A close-up of the young girl eating a piece of chicken with an enthusiastic expression. (10) The final shot shows the completed dish in the red bowl with scallions on top, and a yellow graphic appears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice introducing a product. Fast-paced, upbeat electronic pop music plays in the background. The speech is clear and authoritative. (2) A sharp impact sound effect (thud) occurs as the camera focuses on the product packaging, followed by the man describing the ingredients. (3) Short, percussive sounds of a knife hitting a wooden surface are audible as the chicken is sliced, mixed with the ongoing BGM. (4) The male narrator's voice rises in pitch and volume to express excitement about the taste, while the music maintains a steady, driving rhythm. (5) Subtle chewing or slurping mouth sounds are heard momentarily over the music as the scene transitions to eating, ending with a final enthusiastic verbal call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Introduction -> Preparation Display -> Consumption Testimony -> Recommendation.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an energetic and highly positive endorsement of a specific boneless oil chicken leg product sold at PX Mart (全聯). It uses family-oriented testimony and visual preparation cues to entice viewers to purchase the item.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly mentions the store '全聯' (PX Mart), the price '209', and explicitly recommends the product with a variety text '推薦'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-arousal social media style with fast cuts and bold subtitles to maintain engagement. The inclusion of the family and pet adds a layer of lifestyle warmth to the commercial intent.
